description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to Type 1 and Type 2 font tables in the FreeType project, specifically for PostScript fonts. It includes structures for font info, private dictionaries, CID font info, and functions to retrieve font info, private data, and glyph names.

methods.name: FT_Has_PS_Glyph_Names
methods.description: Returns true if the face provides reliable PostScript glyph names.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Info
methods.description: Retrieves the font info structure for a PostScript font.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Private
methods.description: Retrieves the private dictionary structure for a PostScript font.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Value
methods.description: Retrieves a specific value from a PostScript font's dictionary based on a key.
